svg.text: All modules write to Message Queue (MQ)

g.text: AGENT CORE - Event Processing & Communication Engine
POSIX Message Queue | Unix Domain Sockets
Monitors MQ, network sockets, signals (SIGUSR1 reload)
Thread pool: dispatch, receiver, state, request
Routes MQ events → Buffer or Direct Send
• Memory bounded: Circular buffer limits (default 5000 msgs ≈ 500MB)
• Non-blocking I/O: select() multiplexing, epoll on Linux
typedef struct { void *data; size_t size; } buffered_message;
FULL: buffer = 100% (alert sent, drops oldest if configured)
FLOOD: after tolerance seconds in FULL (alert sent)
• Survives manager disconnection (queues locally for hours/days)
• Multi-manager failover: tries servers in order
• Replays all buffered events on reconnection
1. Add random 5-char prefix + global counter (10d) + local counter (4d)
Global counter (1-65535) + Local counter (1-9997) | Manager validates sequence
Header: "#AES:" or ":" prefix indicates encryption type
Agent → Manager: Events | Manager → Agent: AR commands, config updates
Forward to Engine via UDS Socket
Local Intelligence (Agent is NOT just a forwarder):
• Anti-flooding prevents server overload (EPS throttling, circular buffer)
• Local filtering reduces noise (regex ignore rules in logcollector)
• Autonomous operation during manager outage (continues collecting, buffers locally)
• Delta sync minimizes bandwidth (DBSync protocol for syscollector)
• Event compression (zlib) reduces network traffic by 5-15x
